Police officer's wife reports home break-in and alleges husband abducted in Balrampur

In Balrampur, the wife of a police officer returned home and found the door lock broken. She discovered that jewellery and cash were missing from the house. The woman went to the local police station, crying and stating that her husband had been abducted. She also placed a phone call to her husband after the incident. Police opened an investigation into the alleged theft and the abduction claim. No further details on arrests or recovery were provided in the reports.
